checks.source_quote: We examined the use of limited external feedback in experimental science by comparing reaction-condition search at matched experiment counts. RSI-Anything used worldmodel yield predictions to rank candidate conditions for experimental evaluation. In coding, CURE co-evolves code generation and unit testing through execution feedback [14], while Self-Improving Coding Agent and Darwin Godel Machine iteratively modify agent implementations and retain empirically validated improvements [29, 30]. checks.source_quote: Verifiers, self-training, preference optimization, and verbal feedback turn evaluated trajectories into signals for selection and learning [1–5]. CURE [14] co-evolves a coder and unit tester, providing the ReasonFlux-Coder policy used in our code evaluation. RLAnything jointly optimizes the policy, reward model, and environment through feedback [21]. These approaches motivate the feedback-to-policy part of RSI-Anything. Our framework additionally makes world-model reliability and policy–model compatibility explicit in update acceptance: changing the policy changes the candidate distribution on which its predictor must be evaluated.

checks.source_quote: World Models [6], MuZero [8], Dreamer [7], and Genie [38] establish predictive environments as a basis for control, planning, and interactive generation. Joint-embedding predictive architectures learn latent targets without reconstructing every observation detail [10–12], and JEPA-Anything extends this line through OPF across heterogeneous data types [9]. Building on these predictive capabilities, RSI-Anything organizes how predictions and observed outcomes guide action selection and the acceptance of subsequent policy or world-model versions.

checks.assessment: 核对科学/实验室代理与本文拼接方式。VLA 与 cross-embodiment 数据集作为物理系统动作条件模型的动机[39–41]、LabHorizon 度量 visual next-action prediction 与 protocol-aligned planning[22]、化学侧工具/yield predictors/贝叶斯优化/机器人实验室[28,42–46]、ReactionT5 支持 product/retrosynthesis/yield prediction[47]、single-cell foundation models 与 perturbation predictors[48–51] 的配对均与原文一致。关键纠正：原文只说本文 chemistry adapter 组合 ReactionT5 的 reaction-prediction backbone 与 JEPA-Anything[9] 的 predictive design 做 action-conditioned yield forecasting，初稿将 VLA 列为其组件，已改回原文归因。transition and feedback contract 连接各领域的表述与原文一致；初稿“自主发现与验证”为概括措辞，已标为解读而非原文主张。
checks.source_quote: Vision-language-action and cross-embodiment datasets motivate action-conditioned models for physical systems [39–41]. LabHorizon measures visual next-action prediction and protocol-aligned planning [22]. In chemistry, language-model tools, yield predictors, Bayesian optimization, and robotic laboratories provide complementary components for selecting and testing reactions [28, 42–46]. ReactionT5 [47] is a reaction-pretrained transformer that supports product, retrosynthesis, and yield prediction; our chemistry adapter combines this reaction-prediction backbone with the predictive design of JEPA-Anything [9] for action-conditioned yield forecasting. Single-cell foundation models and perturbation predictors support cellular-response forecasting [48–51]. RSI-Anything connects these domain capabilities through a common transition and feedback contract, so that the outcome of a program, experiment, or intervention can inform candidate selection and subsequent system updates.

checks.assessment: 逐项核对：(1)“两个角色”对应原文 informing which actions receive external feedback 与 providing a predictor that can itself improve from that feedback，准确；(2) 原文把代码修复增益归于 Predictive selection and model adaptation，把实验室规划改进归于 retained policy versions，初稿原总结中“结合预测选择与模型适应在实验室规划等任务带来提升”属归因滑动，已在 summary 与批注中纠正；(3) GUI 的减少重复点击/错误提交限定于 checkbox 任务，已在批注中补上限定；(4) 共同贡献契合原文 procedure for using prediction–observation pairs to guide current actions and assess changes to the system，准确。
checks.source_quote: The results support two roles for world models in recursive improvement: informing which actions receive external feedback and providing a predictor that can itself improve from that feedback. Predictive selection and model adaptation yielded successive gains in code repair, while retained policy versions improved laboratory planning. In GUI tasks, RSI-Anything updated both the policy and the world model and achieved higher task completion, with fewer repeated clicks and incorrect-submission episodes on the checkbox task. Together with measured-feedback search and the end-to-end immunescience workflow, these findings connect prediction-guided decisions to learning and retained system changes. The common contribution is a procedure for using prediction– observation pairs to guide current actions and assess changes to the system that will make subsequent decisions.

checks.source_quote: The design links decisions about actions to decisions about system versions. Pairing predictions with observations allows the same experience to inform candidate utility and predictive reliability. Policies and world models can change on diferent schedules: a reliable predictor can support policy or workflow development, and new outcome evidence can motivate predictor adaptation while the policy remains fixed. Reliability checks govern when model adaptation is attempted, and component and compatibility checks govern which version is carried forward. Retaining accepted versions makes subsequent experience depend on the system’s accumulated improvements.

The evaluations support predictive selection, predictor adaptation, successive policy improvement, and feedbackguided search in their respective settings. Joint multiround evaluation is needed to establish sustained mutual improvement of the policy and world model within a single task. The present laboratory results assess protocol-aligned planning; reliable physical execution requires evaluation on the relevant equipment and workflows. The chemistry results cover two Suzuki–Miyaura screens under the reported experiment budgets, and the therapeutic hypothesis generated in the immune-science application awaits experimental testing.

The evaluations support predictive selection, predictor adaptation, successive policy improvement, and feedbackguided search in their respective settings. Joint multiround evaluation is needed to establish sustained mutual improvement of the policy and world model within a single task. The present laboratory results assess protocol-aligned planning; reliable physical execution requires evaluation on the relevant equipment and workflows. The chemistry results cover two Suzuki–Miyaura screens under the reported experiment budgets, and the therapeutic hypothesis generated in the immune-science application awaits experimental testing.

checks.claim: 适用于代码生成、GUI 自动化、科学实验规划与发现等需高效利用有限反馈的场景
checks.assessment: 领域清单（代码修复、GUI 交互、实验室规划、反应优化）有原文直接支持；“需高效利用有限反馈的场景”属应用推广，原文只声明在受限交互预算与匹配实验次数下评估，该推广已在 relevance 字段内标注为推断。
checks.source_quote: We examined how world-model predictions improve action selection, how retained updates support further improvement, and how prediction and feedback guide decisions under limited interaction budgets. Code repair and GUI interaction cover general computational tasks, alongside physical-domain laboratory planning and experimental reaction optimization. Within these settings, we evaluate predictive selection, model adaptation, task completion, successive policy versions, and search at matched experiment counts. We then examine an end-to-end application of RSI-Anything in immune science, connecting scientific-agent workflow evolution, world-model construction, and scientific analysis.

checks.claim: 领域通用递归自我改进框架，含形式化机制与门控保留协议
checks.assessment: 原文称 RSI-Anything 为 “a domain-general framework that integrates predictive world models with feedback-driven recursive improvement”；“形式化机制”对应 2.1–2.5 的 Eq.1–18 定义，“门控保留协议”对应 Eq.13–18 与三类数据划分（s3:b61:p0）。这是结构描述而非性能主张。
checks.source_quote: To address these challenges, we introduce RSI-Anything, a domain-general framework that integrates predictive world models with feedback-driven recursive improvement (Figure 2). World-model predictions guide action selection, prioritize external evaluations, and support learning-data selection or construction. External feedback drives policy learning or workflow revision and triggers world-model adaptation when reliability checks warrant it. The policy and world model can evolve asynchronously, with component-level checks evaluating individual updates and compatibility checks determining which policy–model pair is retained. This retained pair shapes subsequent candidates and learning experience, closing the recursive improvement loop.

checks.claim: 如何在外部反馈昂贵且策略与世界模型双向耦合的条件下，实现递归自我改进（RSI）
checks.assessment: “双向耦合”有该片段直接支持（策略更新改变世界模型所依赖的候选与经验分布，世界模型更新改变候选排序与学习信号）；“外部反馈昂贵”出自摘要（s1:b1:p0）与 Introduction 第 3 段（s2:b3:p0），属跨片段组合表述，已在 research_question 中以同一句并列呈现而非归于单一出处。
checks.source_quote: Closing this loop introduces a coupled-update challenge. Policy updates change the candidate actions and experience distributions on which the world model operates, potentially undermining prediction reliability. Conversely, world-model updates alter candidate rankings, imagined trajectories, and the learning signals guiding policy improvement. Consequently, improving either component independently does not guarantee better joint performance. Reliable RSI therefore requires determining when to update each component, assessing prediction reliability under changing policies, and ensuring that retained policy–model pairs improve subsequent interaction and learning.
